paragraphs.text: The Harbour Café is looking for a weekend assistant to start in April. The job involves serving customers, preparing sandwiches and keeping the café clean. No experience is necessary, as full training will be given.
Hours are 8 am to 4 pm on Saturdays and Sundays, with a 30-minute lunch break. The pay is £11.50 per hour, and staff receive a free meal on each shift.
Applicants must be at least 18 years old. To apply, send a short letter explaining why you would like the job to the manager, Tom Price, by email. Interviews will be held in the second week of March.

The café is five minutes’ walk from the railway station, and staff can park without charge behind the harbour office. Please note that the café is closed from 24 December to 2 January. A black T-shirt and an apron will be provided, and staff should wear comfortable shoes.

items.quote: looking for a weekend assistant to start in April

explanation.en: “to start in April” → April. “March” in paragraph 3 is the interview month.
explanation.kk: «to start in April» → April. 3-абзацтағы «March» — әңгімелесу айы.
explanation.ru: «to start in April» → April. «March» из абзаца 3 — месяц собеседований.

items.quote: No experience is necessary, as full training will be given

explanation.en: “No experience is necessary, as full training will be given” → full. “Training” is already in the note; only the word before it is needed.
explanation.kk: «No experience is necessary, as full training will be given» → full. «Training» сөзі жазбада тұр, оның алдындағы анықтауыш қана керек.
explanation.ru: «No experience is necessary, as full training will be given» → full. Слово «training» уже есть в заметке, нужен только признак перед ним.

explanation.en: “with a 30-minute lunch break” → 30. The 8 and 4 in the same sentence are the start and end of the shift, not the break.
explanation.kk: «with a 30-minute lunch break» → 30. Сол сөйлемдегі 8 бен 4 — ауысымның басы мен соңы, үзілістің ұзақтығы емес.
explanation.ru: «with a 30-minute lunch break» → 30. Числа 8 и 4 в том же предложении — начало и конец смены, а не длина перерыва.

items.quote: staff receive a free meal on each shift
items.prompt: Extra benefit: a free 4 ____ on each shift

explanation.en: “staff receive a free meal on each shift” → meal. “Free” and “on each shift” are already in the note; the gap is the noun itself.
explanation.kk: «staff receive a free meal on each shift» → meal. «Free» мен «on each shift» жазбада тұр, бос орынға зат есімнің өзі керек.
explanation.ru: «staff receive a free meal on each shift» → meal. «Free» и «on each shift» уже стоят в заметке, пропуск — само существительное.

items.quote: Interviews will be held in the second week of March

explanation.en: “in the second week of March” → March. Do not confuse it with April, the start month.
explanation.kk: «in the second week of March» → March. Жұмыс басталатын April айымен шатастырмаңыз.
explanation.ru: «in the second week of March» → March. Не путать с April — месяцем начала работы.
